findings.title: Repeated style bundle
findings.rationale: When the same surface or chrome bundle appears across files, it usually wants a named variant, tokenized preset, or shared primitive treatment.

evidence.excerpt: { border: `1px solid ${colors.lineSoft}`, borderRadius: radius[24], background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96)', padding: spacing[18], display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: spacing[10], }

findings.suggestedFix: Promote the repeated bundle into a named shared variant, tokenized preset, or shared primitive surface helper.

findings.title: Repeated contract fragment
findings.rationale: When the same container fragment is copied across multiple contracts, it usually wants a shared contract helper or a more explicit generic container role.

evidence.excerpt: { name: 'Layer2_Body_Backdrop', layer: 'Layer2', parent: 'Layer1_Body_ScreenBodyField', display: 'flex', layoutMode: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'stretch', justifyContent: 'stretch', padding: '0', gap: '0', overflow: 'hidden', textAlign: 'left', style: { gridColumn: '1', gridRow: '1', minWidth: 0, minHeight: 0, position: 'relative', pointerEvents: 'none', }, }

findings.suggestedFix: Extract the repeated contract fragment into a shared helper or promote the structural role into an existing generic contract helper.

findings.title: Shared primitive variant drift
findings.message: 2 shared foundation files use the same style family with 2 bespoke literal bundles.
findings.rationale: Shared foundation files should not solve the same presentational problem with slightly different bespoke bundles unless that variation is intentionally named.

evidence.excerpt: { minHeight: editorSurfaceMetrics.headerBadgeHeight, padding: editorSurfaceMetrics.headerBadgeInlineInset, borderRadius: radius.pill, border: editorSurfaceChrome.headerBadgeOutline, background: editorSurfaceChrome.headerBadgeSurface, color: editorSurfaceChrome.headerBadgeTone, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontFamily: typography.eyebrowLabel.fontFamily, fontSize: typography.eyebrowLabel.fontSize, lineHeight: typography.eyebrowLabel.lineHeight, letterSpacing: typography.eyebrowLabel.letterSpacing, textTransform: typography.eyebrowLabel.textTransform, boxShadow: editorSurfaceChrome.headerBadgeHighlight, flexShrink: 0, }

findings.suggestedFix: Either promote the family into a named shared variant or collapse the slightly different bundles into one documented preset.
